items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "My father don't drink coffee."
items.reteach: My father (he) memakai doesn't.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "She can sings very well."
items.reteach: Setelah can, verb bentuk dasar: can sing.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "There is many people at the market."
items.reteach: People jamak: There are many people.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "He go to the mosque every Friday."
items.reteach: He + verb-s: He goes.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "Does your brother plays chess?"
items.reteach: Setelah does, verb bentuk dasar: play.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "We was very happy at the party."
items.reteach: We memakai were.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "I am agree with you."
items.reteach: Agree sudah verb, tidak perlu am: I agree with you.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "The picture hangs at the wall."
items.reteach: Benda yang menempel di dinding: on the wall.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "Listen to me careful."
items.reteach: Untuk menerangkan verb listen, pakai adverb carefully.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "I have two sister."
items.reteach: Two diikuti bentuk jamak: two sisters.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "An university is a big school."
items.reteach: University dibaca "yu-", bunyi konsonan, jadi A university.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "Rina and Tono is my cousins."
items.reteach: Dua orang memakai are.

items.prompt: Bayu text: The subject of "His school is not far" is …

stimulus.text: Bayu lives in Sidoarjo. Every morning he rides his bike to school. His school is not far, so he arrives early. He likes science and art.

items.reteach: Yang dibicarakan adalah His school.

items.prompt: Bayu text: Why does Bayu arrive early?

stimulus.text: Bayu lives in Sidoarjo. Every morning he rides his bike to school. His school is not far, so he arrives early. He likes science and art.

items.reteach: His school is not far, so he arrives early.

items.prompt: Bayu text: Which word joins two ideas in the third sentence?

stimulus.text: Bayu lives in Sidoarjo. Every morning he rides his bike to school. His school is not far, so he arrives early. He likes science and art.

items.reteach: So adalah conjunction yang menunjukkan akibat.

items.prompt: Library rules: What kind of sentences are the rules?

stimulus.text: LIBRARY RULES: Keep quiet. Return books on time. Do not eat or drink inside. Wash your hands before reading old books.

items.reteach: Keep, Return, Do not, Wash = kalimat perintah.

items.prompt: Library rules: Which activity is NOT allowed?

stimulus.text: LIBRARY RULES: Keep quiet. Return books on time. Do not eat or drink inside. Wash your hands before reading old books.

items.reteach: Do not eat or drink inside.

items.prompt: Library rules: "Return books on time" means students must …

stimulus.text: LIBRARY RULES: Keep quiet. Return books on time. Do not eat or drink inside. Wash your hands before reading old books.

visual.text: bring the books back by the due date

choices.say: bring the books back by the due date

items.reteach: Return = mengembalikan, on time = tepat waktu.

items.prompt: Grandmother text: Why is "There is" used before "a mango tree"?

stimulus.text: My grandmother has a small garden. There are tomatoes, chillies and spinach in it. There is also a mango tree. She waters the plants twice a day.

items.reteach: There is untuk satu benda.

items.prompt: Grandmother text: "it" in the second sentence refers to …

stimulus.text: My grandmother has a small garden. There are tomatoes, chillies and spinach in it. There is also a mango tree. She waters the plants twice a day.

items.reteach: Tomatoes, chillies and spinach in it = di kebun.

items.prompt: Grandmother text: In "She waters the plants", the verb has -s because the subject is …

stimulus.text: My grandmother has a small garden. There are tomatoes, chillies and spinach in it. There is also a mango tree. She waters the plants twice a day.

items.reteach: He/she/it + verb-s.

items.prompt: Sinta text: Which sentence from the text is a compound sentence?

stimulus.text: Yesterday was Sinta's birthday. Her friends came to her house. They brought a big chocolate cake. Everyone sang, and Sinta blew out the candles.

visual.text: Everyone sang, and Sinta blew out the candles.

choices.say: Everyone sang, and Sinta blew out the candles.

visual.text: Her friends came to her house.

choices.say: Her friends came to her house.

visual.text: They brought a big chocolate cake.

choices.say: They brought a big chocolate cake.

items.reteach: Dua klausa (Everyone sang + Sinta blew out the candles) digabung dengan and.

items.prompt: Sinta text: The object of "They brought a big chocolate cake" is …

stimulus.text: Yesterday was Sinta's birthday. Her friends came to her house. They brought a big chocolate cake. Everyone sang, and Sinta blew out the candles.

items.reteach: Yang dibawa adalah objeknya: a big chocolate cake.

items.prompt: Sinta text: "They" in the third sentence refers to …

stimulus.text: Yesterday was Sinta's birthday. Her friends came to her house. They brought a big chocolate cake. Everyone sang, and Sinta blew out the candles.

items.reteach: Her friends came … They brought … = teman-teman Sinta.

items.prompt: Ana: "You like batik, ___?" Bimo: "Yes, I do."
items.reteach: Question tag: kalimat positif dengan like, tag-nya don't you.

items.prompt: Tourist: "___ any toilets near here?" Guard: "Yes, next to the mosque."
items.reteach: Toilets jamak: Are there any toilets?

items.prompt: Mother: "Is your sister at home?" Son: "No, she ___."
items.reteach: Pertanyaan dengan Is dijawab No, she isn't.

items.prompt: Teacher: "Do your friends live near the school?" Rina: "Yes, they ___."
items.reteach: Pertanyaan dengan Do dijawab Yes, they do.

items.prompt: Seller at Pasar Atom: "Would you like ___ bag?" Buyer: "No, thanks."
items.reteach: Bag diawali bunyi konsonan: a bag.

items.prompt: Raka: "I can't swim." Dina: "___ can I."
items.reteach: Setuju dengan kalimat negatif: Neither can I.

items.prompt: Raka: "I love fried rice." Dina: "So ___ I."
items.reteach: I love … memakai do: So do I.

items.prompt: Bu Ana: "Where's the remote?" Ayah: "It's ___ the sofa, under the cushion."
items.reteach: Benda di atas permukaan sofa: on the sofa.

items.prompt: Doni: "What does your father do?" Eka: "___ a fisherman in Madura."
items.reteach: He's = He is: He is a fisherman.

items.prompt: Tourist: "Excuse me, how ___ is Tugu Pahlawan from here?" Local: "About one kilometre."
items.reteach: Menanyakan jarak: How far?

items.prompt: Rina: "Whose shoes ___ these?" Mia: "They're my brother's."
items.reteach: Shoes dan these jamak: are.

items.prompt: Ibu: "Don't play outside. It ___ heavily." Kids: "OK, Mum."
items.reteach: Hujan sedang turun sekarang: It is raining.

items.prompt: Susun menjadi kalimat yang benar: never / late / is / Andi / school / for

visual.text: Andi is never late for school.

choices.say: Andi is never late for school.

visual.text: Andi is late never for school.

choices.say: Andi is late never for school.

visual.text: Never Andi is late for school.

choices.say: Never Andi is late for school.

visual.text: Andi is for school never late.

choices.say: Andi is for school never late.

items.reteach: Never diletakkan setelah to be: is never late.

items.prompt: Ubah menjadi kalimat negatif: "Lusi likes durian."
items.reteach: He/she + doesn't + verb dasar.

items.prompt: Ubah menjadi kalimat tanya: "They are from Jember."
items.reteach: Pindahkan are ke depan subjek: Are they …?

items.prompt: Ubah menjadi kalimat tanya: "Your uncle works in a bank."

visual.text: Does your uncle work in a bank?

choices.say: Does your uncle work in a bank?

visual.text: Does your uncle works in a bank?

choices.say: Does your uncle works in a bank?

visual.text: Do your uncle work in a bank?

choices.say: Do your uncle work in a bank?

visual.text: Is your uncle work in a bank?

choices.say: Is your uncle work in a bank?

items.reteach: Does + subjek + verb dasar.

items.prompt: Gabungkan dengan "but": "The bag is cheap." + "It is very strong."

visual.text: The bag is cheap, but it is very strong.

choices.say: The bag is cheap, but it is very strong.

visual.text: The bag is cheap but strong it is very.

choices.say: The bag is cheap but strong it is very.

visual.text: But the bag is cheap it is very strong.

choices.say: But the bag is cheap it is very strong.

visual.text: The bag but is cheap, it is very strong.

choices.say: The bag but is cheap, it is very strong.

items.reteach: Klausa 1 + koma + but + klausa 2.

items.prompt: Gabungkan dengan "because": "We stayed inside." + "It was raining."

visual.text: We stayed inside because it was raining.

choices.say: We stayed inside because it was raining.

visual.text: It was raining because we stayed inside.

choices.say: It was raining because we stayed inside.

visual.text: Because we stayed inside it was raining.

choices.say: Because we stayed inside it was raining.

visual.text: We stayed because inside it was raining.

choices.say: We stayed because inside it was raining.

items.reteach: Because diikuti alasan: it was raining.

items.prompt: Susun menjadi kalimat yang benar: delicious / Ibu / a / cooked / soup
items.reteach: Adjective sebelum noun: a delicious soup.

items.prompt: Ubah menjadi kalimat perintah yang sopan: "You should close the window."
items.reteach: Please + verb dasar.

items.prompt: Susun menjadi kalimat yang benar: the / students / in / are / hall / the / all

visual.text: All the students are in the hall.

choices.say: All the students are in the hall.

visual.text: The all students are in the hall.

choices.say: The all students are in the hall.

visual.text: Students all the are in the hall.

choices.say: Students all the are in the hall.

visual.text: All the students in are the hall.

choices.say: All the students in are the hall.

items.reteach: All diletakkan sebelum the: all the students.

items.prompt: Ubah menjadi kalimat seru (exclamation): "The view is very beautiful."
items.reteach: Pola: What a + adjective + noun + !

items.prompt: Gabungkan dengan "and" yang paling tepat: "Rio plays the guitar." + "Rio sings."

visual.text: Rio plays the guitar and sings.

choices.say: Rio plays the guitar and sings.

visual.text: Rio plays the guitar and he sing.

choices.say: Rio plays the guitar and he sing.

visual.text: Rio and plays the guitar sings.

choices.say: Rio and plays the guitar sings.

visual.text: Rio plays and the guitar sings.

choices.say: Rio plays and the guitar sings.

items.reteach: Subjek sama cukup ditulis sekali: plays … and sings.

items.prompt: Susun menjadi kalimat tanya: there / any / juice / in / is / the fridge

visual.text: Is there any juice in the fridge?

choices.say: Is there any juice in the fridge?

visual.text: There is any juice in the fridge?

choices.say: There is any juice in the fridge?

visual.text: Is any there juice in the fridge?

choices.say: Is any there juice in the fridge?

visual.text: Is there juice any in the fridge?

choices.say: Is there juice any in the fridge?

items.reteach: Pola "Is there any …?" dipakai untuk bertanya.

items.prompt: Odd one out: which one is NOT a complete sentence?
items.reteach: Running in the rain tidak punya subjek dan verb utama.

items.prompt: Puzzle: Put the words in order: school / walk / I / to. What is the third word?
items.reteach: Kalimatnya I walk to school. Kata ketiga: to.

items.prompt: Puzzle: "I ___ a student. You ___ a student. He ___ a student." Which group fills the blanks in order?
items.reteach: I am, you are, he is.

items.prompt: Word logic: "Cats chase mice" is Subject – Verb – Object. Which sentence is also Subject – Verb – Object?
items.reteach: Dogs (S) love (V) bones (O).

items.prompt: Analogy: "he" is to "is" as "they" is to …
items.reteach: He is, they are.

items.prompt: Puzzle: How many words must be changed to fix "She have two brother."?
items.reteach: Have menjadi has, brother menjadi brothers: dua kata.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am a short word. I join "bread" and "butter" in a famous pair. What am I?
items.reteach: Bread and butter.

items.prompt: Code: S = subject, V = verb, O = object. What is "Grandpa reads the newspaper."?
items.reteach: Grandpa (S) reads (V) the newspaper (O).

items.prompt: Puzzle: Which word can fill BOTH blanks? "___ you tired?" and "They ___ my friends."
items.reteach: Are you tired? They are my friends.

items.prompt: Puzzle: Which word can fill BOTH blanks? "___ she like milk?" and "He ___ his homework at night."
items.reteach: Does she like milk? He does his homework at night.

items.prompt: Odd one out: Kalimat mana yang kurang tepat? "She sings." "He dances." "They cook." "It rain."
items.reteach: It + verb-s: It rains.

items.prompt: Puzzle: Move ONE word to fix "Always she is kind." The correct sentence is …
items.reteach: Always diletakkan setelah is.
